reason: The cited evidence (E1) discusses V additions to CoCrFeMnNi and links atomic size mismatch to solid solution strengthening and increased frictional stress, but it does not address Al additions, controlled combined Al+V substitutions, or the specific claim that lattice distortions alone govern strength in the absence of secondary phases. The evidence is thus only partially supportive of the key premises.
premises: Substituting Al and V into CoCrFeMnNi increases atomic size mismatch
Increased atomic size mismatch elevates local lattice distortions
Elevated lattice distortions raise the dislocation glide barrier (Peierls barrier)
Higher glide barrier increases yield strength and reduces dislocation mobility
Strength enhancement occurs without secondary phase formation
